# Story Maps for Jira

> Story Maps for Jira is a visual planning app for Jira Cloud. It arranges a Jira backlog along a user journey so teams can plan sprints and releases without leaving Jira. Published by Realigned Technologies.

Two editions ship on the Atlassian Marketplace: Story Maps for Jira and Advanced Story Maps for Jira.

## Product

- [Story Maps for Jira](https://storymapping.app/free-app): visual story mapping for a single Jira project.
- [Advanced Story Maps for Jira](https://storymapping.app/showcase/advanced): custom hierarchies, custom-field swimlanes, multi-project maps, and portfolio planning.
- [Compare editions](https://storymapping.app/download)
